angleRead.text: I will start by reaching out to Wilson Shepard, the Oakland Oaks' Head Coach, who recently moved into a place of their own in West Oakland. I'll ask about their new living situation and how it relates to their team's recent performance. I'll also touch base with Elias Varek, the Founder of Civis Systems, to discuss the recent financial returns for Civis Systems and Varek Systems.
